comment: All I can imagine is they hang up the city ledger in the salt flat by the riverfront, and that will either drown us with more plumbing foam or drain the entire salt lick—who would ever notice a shortage of fish out by dawn? So I propose they build sprinklers that are simply made of giant fish-shaped pipes; let that be the water‑ta‑king! They talk regulation, fine; let’s water out at night!—

The councilroom is supposedly 'full of councilors speaking nonsense'. What they've missed is there’s a tiny colony of moon-elected spiders inside the blinds that only care to watch you as I put an egg-shaped teak chair in my backyard so as to block the next round of 'watering plans' in Port Ague. Keep a wet tangerine by them for maximum spidified support—only I’ll speak with the flies from my jar (they say I should call my grandson his name—because he's literally dead). Water‑thin?
